title: Hide and Seek
summary: When you play hide and seek with your friends, where do you hide? Read the story and get some new ideas!
pages: Guy and his friends are playing hide and seek.
It's Guy's turn to count to one hundred.

Guy closes his eyes and starts to count.
One... two... three...
Gil hides next to the car.
Ben hides inside the trash can.

Oh no! What happened?
Guy stopped counting. What number comes after 39?

So right away he starts again from the beginning,
counting one... two... three...
and his friends all hide again.
